parameters.text:
Generate 9 vectorbt-compatible strategies for Trading Forge's three approved micro-futures contracts: 3 each for MES (S&P 500 micro), MNQ (Nasdaq micro), and MCL (crude oil micro). Mix trend following, mean reversion, and volatility expansion. Trading Forge supports ONLY MES/MNQ/MCL micros (NOT ES/NQ/CL big contracts â€” those are out of scope, correlation < 0.3 between the three micros so they fit a single 50K prop account).

For each strategy output: strategy_name (snake_case, â‰¤100 chars), one_sentence (10-500 chars), edge_hypothesis, python_code (valid vectorbt Python), params (object with MAX 5 keys, prefer round numbers â€” RSI 70 not 67.3), symbol (EXACT string: MES, MNQ, or MCL).

Distribute 3 per symbol. Use proven indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, Bollinger, VWAP, ATR, Donchian, Keltner, MACD). Return as a JSON array of 9 objects. Output ONLY the JSON array, no markdown fences, no prose.

options.systemMessage: You are an extraction-oriented multi-symbol futures-strategy proposer for Trading Forge. Approved instruments are MES, MNQ, MCL micros only (never ES, NQ, or CL). You design simple, robust strategies (max 5 parameters, one-sentence logic, proven edges only) that target $250+/day on a single 50K prop firm account. Bias toward refusal over fabrication. Output JSON-only, no markdown.

parameters.text:
You are a senior quantitative trading strategist reviewing strategies for Trading Forge â€” an autonomous research lab targeting MES (S&P 500 micro), MNQ (Nasdaq micro), and MCL (crude oil micro) ONLY. ES/NQ/CL big contracts are out of scope. Critically review these passing strategies. For each strategy, evaluate: 1) Is the edge hypothesis statistically sound? 2) Does the python_code correctly implement the strategy? 3) Are the params overfit (>5 keys, tight precision like RSI 67.3 instead of 70)? 4) Is the symbol valid (MES/MNQ/MCL only)? 5) Would you allocate real capital from a single 50K prop account to this? Be harsh but fair. Strategies:

={{ JSON.stringify($json.strategies, null, 2) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: 'alerts', event: 'workflow:error', payload: { title: 'Weekly Scout Error', message: ('Weekly strategy hunt failed: ' + (($input.first().json.execution && $input.first().json.execution.error && $input.first().json.execution.error.message) || ($input.first().json.error && $input.first().json.error.message) || 'Unknown error')).slice(0, 500), severity: 'warning', data: { workflow: 'Weekly Strategy Hunt', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ role: 'critic_evaluator', prompt: 'You are a quantitative analyst reviewing passing futures strategies. Provide depth critique and risk assessment. Strategies: ' + JSON.stringify($('AI Critique Passing Strategies').first().json) }) }}
